pulse.text: 1:10 AM Tuesday. The no-idle floor worked all night — five windows claimed within two hours — and then midnight itself broke the build: a database check hardcoded to August's calendar fails everywhere now that it is September. The night watch caught it on its first claim, wrote the full diagnosis (DRIFT-1130), and correctly stopped at its authority line. W122 is fired with a narrow grant to fix the two causes, land on main, and revive every red branch in order. Nothing merges until it does.
